name: Kinergy Advancement Berhad
overview: 2026年，Kinergy Advancement Berhad 通过 KAB Energy Holdings 向 B.Grimm Power Tiara 出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，涉及可持续能源业务的部分权益退出；同时公司多次进行集资活动，并录得季度营收和净利润同比增长。
overview_en: In 2026, Kinergy Advancement Berhad divested 49% of Jati Cakerawala held by KAB Energy Holdings to B.Grimm Power Tiara, involving a partial exit in sustainable energy; the company also conducted multiple fund-raising exercises and recorded year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue and net profit.

segments.name: 可持续能源解决方案
segments.note: 今年通过子公司出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，涉及可持续能源业务的部分权益退出。
segments.note_en: This year, through a subsidiary, divested 49% equity interest in Jati Cakerawala, involving a partial exit in sustainable energy business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: KAB Energy Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 与 B.Grimm Power Tiara Sdn. Bhd. 签订买卖协议，出售 Jati Cakerawala Sdn. Bhd. 49% 股权（1,960,784 股普通股）。
actions.text_en: KAB Energy Holdings Sdn. Bhd. entered into a sale and purchase agreement with B.Grimm Power Tiara Sdn. Bhd. to divest 49% equity interest (1,960,784 ordinary shares) in Jati Cakerawala Sdn. Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团通过子公司出售 Jati Cakerawala 49% 股权，导致在可持续能源业务中的持股比例下降。
model_changes.text_en: The Group, through its subsidiary, divested 49% equity interest in Jati Cakerawala, resulting in a reduced shareholding in the sustainable energy business.
